observe.ask: Lane A (control: static class, 8 s run; turns yellow at the end): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane B (class rebound every 3 s (k1/k2)): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane C (class has a {{binding}} that never changes; page re-renders every 1 s): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane D (steps(4, end): four jumps in 8 s): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane E (translateX 0 to 600 px in 8 s (leaves the screen)): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane F (image, src swapped every 3 s (identical files); dims at the end): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane G (opacity 0 to 1, alternate, 2 s): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
Lane H (BART pattern: class reads a field of an object replaced every 1 s): does it run to the right end (turning yellow) and loop, or jump back early (never yellow) / stop?
